description: Retrieve an authorized map with independent node_offset, edge_offset, and page_size parameters. Canonical IDs are always retained in projected nodes and edges even when include_nodes or include_edges omits id. Use summary for statistics without graph content or compact for token-efficient fields. Search results return copy-safe map references so UUIDs should not be typed manually.

edge_offset.description: Zero-based offset for the independently paginated edge collection.
edge_offset.title: Edge Offset

node_offset.description: Zero-based offset for the independently paginated node collection.
node_offset.title: Node Offset

page_size.description: Maximum nodes and maximum edges returned in this page (1-200).
page_size.title: Page Size

name: get_knowmapped_map
title: Get a KnowMapped map
